# src/scheduler/longrecipe.nim
# Nim Long Recipe Scheduler for JAIDE V35: Distributed scheduling with dependency graphs.

import std/[os, strutils, tables, deques, times, random, json, threads, locks,
            sequtils, sets, hashes, algorithm, math, parsecfg, httpclient,
            asyncdispatch, asynchttpserver, logging, options, strformat]

import tensor # Assume tensor module
import quantum # Assume quantum module
import ssm # Assume SSM module
import kan # Assume KAN module
import tgn # Assume TGN module
import metrics

export tensor, quantum, ssm, kan, tgn, metrics

type
  Config* = object
    dim*: int
    layers*: int
    seq_len*: int
    sparsity*: float
    lr*: float
    epsilon*: float
    num_workers*: int
    batch_size*: int
    epochs*: int
    quantum_shots*: int
    celestial_mu*: float

  TaskKind* = enum
    tkTensor, tkQuantum, tkSSM, tkKAN, tkTGN, tkOptimize, tkTrainStep, tkInfer

  TaskStatus* = enum
    tsPending, tsRunning, tsCompleted, tsFailed

  Dependency* = object
    task_id*: int
    pred_id*: int

  Task* = object
    id*: int
    kind*: TaskKind
    status*: TaskStatus
    deps*: seq[Dependency]
    input*: JsonNode
    output*: Option[JsonNode]
    duration*: float
    worker_id*: int
    promise*: Future[JsonNode]

  Scheduler* = ref object
    config*: Config
    tasks*: seq[Task]
    task_table*: Table[int, int]  # id -> index
    ready_queue*: Deque[int]  # task indices
    running*: HashSet[int]
    completed*: int
    lock*: Lock
    workers*: seq[Thread[void]]
    worker_tasks*: seq[Channel[Task]]
    metrics*: Metrics
    http_server*: Option[HttpClient]
    async_server*: Option[AsyncHttpServer]

  WorkerPool* = object
    workers*: seq[Thread[void]]
    channels*: seq[Channel[Task]]
    scheduler*: Scheduler

proc parse_config(path: string): Config =
  let cfg = loadConfig(path)
  Config(
    dim: cfg.getSectionValue("model", "dim").parseInt(),
    layers: cfg.getSectionValue("model", "layers").parseInt(),
    seq_len: cfg.getSectionValue("model", "seq_len").parseInt(),
    sparsity: cfg.getSectionValue("model", "sparsity").parseFloat(),
    lr: cfg.getSectionValue("optimizer", "lr").parseFloat(),
    epsilon: cfg.getSectionValue("optimizer", "epsilon").parseFloat(),
    num_workers: cfg.getSectionValue("runtime", "num_workers").parseInt(),
    batch_size: cfg.getSectionValue("training", "batch_size").parseInt(),
    epochs: cfg.getSectionValue("training", "epochs").parseInt(),
    quantum_shots: cfg.getSectionValue("quantum", "shots").parseInt(),
    celestial_mu: cfg.getSectionValue("celestial", "mu").parseFloat()
  )

proc new_scheduler(config: Config): Scheduler =
  new result
  result.config = config
  result.tasks = @[]
  result.task_table = initTable
  result.ready_queue = initDeque
  result.running = initSet
  result.completed = 0
  initLock(result.lock)
  result.metrics = new_metrics()
  result.http_server = none(HttpClient)
  result.async_server = none(AsyncHttpServer)

proc add_task(sched: Scheduler, kind: TaskKind, input: JsonNode, deps: seq[int]): Future[JsonNode] =
  withLock(sched.lock):
    let id = sched.tasks.len
    let task = Task(id: id, kind: kind, status: tsPending, deps: @[], input: input)
    sched.tasks.add(task)
    sched.task_table[id] = id
    let fut = newFuture
    task.promise = fut
    for dep_id in deps:
      if dep_id in sched.task_table:
        let pred_idx = sched.task_table[dep_id]
        task.deps.add(Dependency(task_id: id, pred_id: pred_idx))
    if task.deps.len == 0:
      sched.ready_queue.addLast(id)
    result = fut
  sched.schedule()

proc schedule(sched: Scheduler) =
  while sched.ready_queue.len > 0:
    let idx = sched.ready_queue.popFirst()
    withLock(sched.lock):
      if idx in sched.running:
        continue
      sched.running.incl(idx)
      let task = sched.tasks[idx]
      task.status = tsRunning
    spawn worker_execute(sched, idx)

proc worker_execute(sched: Scheduler, idx: int) {.thread.} =
  let start = cpuTime()
  let task = sched.tasks[idx]
  var output: JsonNode
  try:
    case task.kind
    of tkTensor:
      output = %* tensor_op(task.input)
    of tkQuantum:
      output = %* quantum_sim(task.input, sched.config.quantum_shots)
    of tkSSM:
      output = %* ssm_step(task.input, sched.config)
    of tkKAN:
      output = %* kan_layer(task.input, sched.config)
    of tkTGN:
      output = %* tgn_update(task.input, sched.config)
    of tkOptimize:
      output = %* celestial_zo(task.input, sched.config)
    of tkTrainStep:
      output = %* train_step(task.input, sched.config)
    of tkInfer:
      output = %* infer(task.input, sched.config)
    task.output = some(output)
    task.status = tsCompleted
  except:
    task.status = tsFailed
    task.output = some(%* {"error": getCurrentExceptionMsg()})
  let duration = cpuTime() - start
  task.duration = duration
  sched.metrics.record(task.kind, duration)
  withLock(sched.lock):
    sched.running.excl(idx)
    sched.completed.inc
    for dep in task.deps:
      let dep_task_idx = dep.task_id
      if dep_task_idx in sched.task_table:
        let dep_task = sched.tasks[dep_task_idx]
        # Check if all preds completed
        let completed_preds = count(it => it.status == tsCompleted, dep_task.deps.mapIt(sched.tasks[it.pred_id]))
        if completed_preds == dep_task.deps.len:
          sched.ready_queue.addLast(dep_task_idx)
    task.promise.complete(output)
  sched.schedule()

proc tensor_op(input: JsonNode): JsonNode =
  # Full tensor op implementation
  let shape = input["shape"].getElems().mapIt(it.num)
  let data = input["data"].getElems().mapIt(it.num)
  case input["op"].getStr()
  of "matmul":
    let a = new_tensor(shape[0..1], data[0..shape[0]*shape[1]-1])
    let b = new_tensor(shape[2..3], data[shape[0]*shape[1]..^1])
    let res = matmul(a, b)
    %* {"data": %* res.data, "shape": %* res.shape}
  of "conv2d":
    let input_t = new_tensor([1,1,shape[0],shape[1]], data)
    let kernel = new_tensor([1,1,3,3], @[1.0,0,1,0,-4,0,1,0,1])  # Sobel
    let res = conv2d(input_t, kernel, 1, 1)
    %* {"data": %* res.data, "shape": %* res.shape}
  of "relu":
    let t = new_tensor(shape, data)
    relu(t)
    %* {"data": %* t.data, "shape": %* shape}
  of "softmax":
    let t = new_tensor([shape[0]], data)
    softmax(t, 0)
    %* {"data": %* t.data, "shape": %* [shape[0]]}
  else:
    %* {"error": "Unknown tensor op"}

proc quantum_sim(input: JsonNode, shots: int): JsonNode =
  let num_qubits = input["num_qubits"].num.int
  var state = new_quantum_state(num_qubits)
  for gate in input["gates"].getElems():
    let gkind = gate["kind"].getStr()
    let q = gate["qubit"].num.int
    case gkind
    of "hadamard":
      state.apply_hadamard(q)
    of "cnot":
      let target = gate["target"].num.int
      state.apply_cnot(q, target)
    of "rx":
      let angle = gate["angle"].num.float
      state.apply_rx(q, angle)
    of "rz":
      let angle = gate["angle"].num.float
      state.apply_rz(q, angle)
    of "measure":
      let outcomes = state.simulate_shots(shots)
      return %* {"outcomes": %* outcomes}
  let amplitudes = state.amplitudes
  %* {"amplitudes": %* amplitudes.mapIt({it.re: float, it.im: float})}

proc ssm_step(input: JsonNode, config: Config): JsonNode =
  let state_data = input["state"].getElems().mapIt(it.num)
  let input_seq = input["input"].getElems().mapIt(it.num)
  let d_state = state_data.len
  var state = new_vector(state_data)
  let A = new_diagonal([-0.1 * i.float for i in 0..<d_state])  # HiPPO
  let B = new_vector([1.0] * d_state)
  let C = new_vector([1.0] * d_state)
  let dt = config.dt or 0.01
  for t in 0..<input_seq.len:
    state = s4d_update(dt, A, B, C, state, input_seq[t])
  %* {"output": %* state.data}

proc kan_layer(input: JsonNode, config: Config): JsonNode =
  let input_data = input.getElems().mapIt(it.num)
  let grid = config.kan_grid
  let degree = 3
  let coeffs = randn(grid * config.dim, Normal(0.0, 0.1))
  let knots = linspace(0.0, 1.0, grid + degree + 1)
  let x_norm = (input_data .- mean(input_data)) ./ std(input_data)
  let basis = b_spline_basis.(x_norm, knots, degree)
  let output = basis * coeffs
  %* {"output": %* output}

proc tgn_update(input: JsonNode, config: Config): JsonNode =
  let nodes = input["nodes"].getElems().mapIt(it.getElems().mapIt(it.num))
  let edges = input["edges"].getElems().mapIt(it.getElems().mapIt(it.num))
  let time_delta = input["time_delta"].getElems().mapIt(it.num)
  let num_nodes = nodes.len
  let feat_dim = nodes[0].len
  var updated_nodes = copy(nodes)
  for node in 0..<num_nodes:
    var agg = zeros(feat_dim)
    for e in 0..<edges.len:
      let weight = edges[e][0]
      let time_enc = [time_delta[e], sin(time_delta[e]), cos(time_delta[e])]
      agg += weight * time_enc[0..2]
    updated_nodes[node] += agg * 0.1
  %* {"updated_nodes": %* updated_nodes}

proc celestial_zo(input: JsonNode, config: Config): JsonNode =
  let params = input.getElems().mapIt(it.num)
  let epsilon = config.epsilon
  let oracle = (p: seq[float]) => sum(p.^2)  # Quadratic oracle
  let pos_pert = params .+ epsilon * randn(params.len)
  let neg_pert = params .- epsilon * randn(params.len)
  let f_pos = oracle(pos_pert)
  let f_neg = oracle(neg_pert)
  let grad_est = (f_pos - f_neg) / (2 * epsilon)
  let update = -config.lr * grad_est
  let new_params = params + update
  # Spectral clip
  let spec_rad = power_iteration(new_params.reshape((len(params),1)), 10)
  if spec_rad > config.spectral_bound:
    new_params ./= spec_rad / config.spectral_bound
  %* {"grad_est": %* grad_est, "new_params": %* new_params, "spec_rad": %spec_rad}

proc train_step(input: JsonNode, config: Config): JsonNode =
  let batch = input["batch"].getElems().mapIt(it.getElems().mapIt(it.num))
  let labels = input["labels"].getElems().mapIt(it.getElems().mapIt(it.num))
  let loss = 0.0
  for b in 0..<batch.len:
    let embeds = full_embed(batch[b])  # Tokenizer
    let logits = fmrn_forward(embeds, config)  # Model forward
    loss += cross_entropy(logits, labels[b])
  let avg_loss = loss / batch.len
  # Backward and update
  let grads = backward(avg_loss)
  celestial_zo_update(grads, config)
  %* {"loss": %avg_loss, "grad_norm": %norm(grads)}

proc infer(input: JsonNode, config: Config): JsonNode =
  let prompt = input["prompt"].getStr()
  let tokens = tokenize(prompt)
  let embeds = full_embed(tokens)
  let logits = fmrn_forward(embeds, config)
  let next_token = argmax(logits[$-1,:])
  let generated = detokenize([next_token])
  %* {"generated": %generated, "logits": %* logits[$-1,:], "prob": %softmax(logits[$-1,next_token])}

proc power_iteration(mat: Matrix[float], iters: int): float =
  let v = randn(mat.shape)
  var v_norm = v / norm(v)
  for _ in 1..iters:
    v = mat @ v_norm
    v_norm = v / norm(v)
  (v_norm.T @ mat @ v_norm)[0,0]

proc new_scheduler(config_path: string): Scheduler =
  let config = parse_config(config_path)
  new_scheduler(config)

proc start_http_server(sched: Scheduler, port: int = 8080) =
  let client = new_async_http_server()
  client.listen(Port(port), on_request)
  sched.async_server = some(client)
  wait(forever)

proc on_request(req: Request): Future[void] {.async.} =
  case req.httpMethod
  of HttpPost:
    let body = await req.body
    let j = parse_json(body)
    let kind_str = j{"kind"}.getStr()
    let kind = parse_enum[TaskKind](kind_str)
    let deps = j{"deps"}.getElems().mapIt(it.num.int)
    let fut = sched.add_task(kind, j{"input"}, deps)
    let res = await fut
    req.respond(Http200, %* {"result": res})
  of HttpGet:
    if req.path.startsWith("/metrics"):
      req.respond(Http200, %* sched.metrics.to_json())
    else:
      req.respond(Http404, %* {"error": "Not found"})
  else:
    req.respond(Http405, %* {"error": "Method not allowed"})

proc main() =
  addHandler(newConsoleLogger())
  let sched = new_scheduler("config.cfg")
  # Add sample tasks
  for i in 0..<10:
    let input = %* {"data": %* [1.0,2.0,3.0]}
    discard sched.add_task(tkTensor, input, @[])
  start_http_server(sched)

when isMainModule:
  main()

# End of longrecipe.nim

  if spec_rad > config.spectral_bound:
    new_params ./= spec_rad / config.spectral_bound
  %* {"grad_est": %* grad_est, "new_params": %* new_params, "spec_rad": %spec_rad}

proc train_step(input: JsonNode, config: Config): JsonNode =
  let batch = input["batch"].getElems().mapIt(it.getElems().mapIt(it.num))
  let labels = input["labels"].getElems().mapIt(it.getElems().mapIt(it.num))
  let loss = 0.0
  for b in 0..<batch.len:
    let embeds = full_embed(batch[b])  # Tokenizer
    let logits = fmrn_forward(embeds, config)  # Model forward
    loss += cross_entropy(logits, labels[b])
  let avg_loss = loss / batch.len
  # Backward and update
  let grads = backward(avg_loss)
  celestial_zo_update(grads, config)
  %* {"loss": %avg_loss, "grad_norm": %norm(grads)}

  let prompt = input["prompt"].getStr()
  let tokens = tokenize(prompt)
  let embeds = full_embed(tokens)
  let logits = fmrn_forward(embeds, config)
  let next_token = argmax(logits[$-1,:])
  let generated = detokenize([next_token])
  %* {"generated": %generated, "logits": %* logits[$-1,:], "prob": %softmax(logits[$-1,next_token])}

proc power_iteration(mat: Matrix[float], iters: int): float =
  let v = randn(mat.shape)
  var v_norm = v / norm(v)
  for _ in 1..iters:
    v = mat @ v_norm
    v_norm = v / norm(v)
  (v_norm.T @ mat @ v_norm)[0,0]

  let client = new_async_http_server()
  client.listen(Port(port), on_request)
  sched.async_server = some(client)
  wait(forever)

proc on_request(req: Request): Future[void] {.async.} =
  case req.httpMethod
  of HttpPost:
    let body = await req.body
    let j = parse_json(body)
    let kind_str = j{"kind"}.getStr()
    let kind = parse_enum[TaskKind](kind_str)
    let deps = j{"deps"}.getElems().mapIt(it.num.int)
    let fut = sched.add_task(kind, j{"input"}, deps)
    let res = await fut
    req.respond(Http200, %* {"result": res})
  of HttpGet:
    if req.path.startsWith("/metrics"):

    else:

  else:
    req.respond(Http405, %* {"error": "Method not allowed"})

    discard sched.add_task(tkTensor, input, @[])
